_comment: Curated, safe public abstracts for PRIVATE projects. A private project appears on grahama.co ONLY as the abstract below, and ONLY when approved_by/approved_at are set. Visibility is detected automatically (gh repo view) by gen_visibility.py; when a repo flips public<->private the nightly monitor-website refresh flips the site. Abstract text is curated-safe (never auto-derived from private content): no client/program names, private repos, source paths, or evidence counts.

sparta-explorer.name: SPARTA — space-cyber evidence workbench
sparta-explorer.abstract: A governed evidence workbench for space-system cyber compliance: every claim traces back to the human decision that owns it, so relevance never silently becomes authority. The reasoning methodology is public; the deployed application and its evidence base are private.
sparta-explorer.disclosure_boundary: No client or program names, private repositories, source paths, or evidence counts. Methodology is public; the deployed system and its data are not.

memory.name: Memory — graph recall operator
memory.abstract: A private graph-memory operator for agent lessons, code navigation, and recall routing. Public details are limited to the architecture pattern: ArangoDB owns documents and graph edges, Qdrant owns vectors, and agents query memory before scanning code.
memory.disclosure_boundary: No private repository contents, database records, credentials, local service endpoints, or operational memory data. Public claims are limited to architecture, command shape, and project role.
